sloka: गजकन्या गजाश्चैव हेमकक्ष्या: पताकिन: ।जीमूता इव घर्मान्ते सघोषा: सम्प्रतस्थिरे ॥ २.९२.३३॥
transliteration: gajakanyā gajāścaiva hemakakṣyā: patākina: ।jīmūtā iva gharmānte saghoṣā: sampratasthire ॥ 2.92.33॥

translations.english: The male and female elephants wearing golden girths and decorated with pennants, set forth with their bells sounding like thunderclouds at the end of summer.
